title: Aim Utils
description: Utilities for aiming enthusiasts. Adds fine-grained control for mouse sensitivity
body:
## Aim Utils

Utilities for more fine-grained control over mouse sensitivity for aimers.

The sensitivity value can now be set to the nearest 0.00001 as compared to the vanilla slider being to the nearest 0.005 and having weird rounding issues.

The mod also provides the ability to randomize your sensitivity within a specific range to help with aim tension.

`/sens` to open the configuration menu (also available in Mod Menu), `/randomizesens` to randomize.

This mod requires YACL to be configured.

![Configuration Screen for Aim Utils](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e36b5c1e57cd79f09d7946f03d63e580971c4f0_0.webp)

reach out: `@tektonikal` for support / suggestions.
